answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a relay voyage: an application must cross an ocean of checkpoints before earning full rights. First, it files a public key plus a 250 POA bond. Second, four unrelated established operators each stake 250 POA on its honesty. Third, each hop takes seven days, with a live task at every stop. Fourth, any checkpoint can slash the bond and sink it on fraud. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 40,000 slots, $10,000,000 in bonds, and 280,000 days of waiting. Like a ship clearing every harbor on the horizon before docking, no shortcut reaches shore. - Jowy
